Assessment.content: Probable simple urinary tract infection (bladder infection).
Assessment.source_text: I think probably do have what we call a simple UTI or urinary tract infection, bladder infection, um, which can be readily treated.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe a course of antibiotics for UTI.

Plan_of_Care.content: Antibiotic options are nitrofurantoin or trimethoprim.

Plan_of_Care.content: Take one tablet twice daily for three days.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise increased oral fluids to help flush the infection.
